message.content:
抱歉，我無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。建議您可以參考以下幾個常用來源來取得美國今日黃金價格：

| 平台 | 特色 | 連結 |
|------|------|------|
| Bloomberg | 提供即時行情、新聞與分析 | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets |
| Reuters | 全球金融資訊，含黃金即時報價 | https://www.reuters.com/markets |
| Kitco | 專門的貴金屬價格網站，提供日內更新 | https://www.kitco.com |
| Investing.com | 金融市場數據平台，含黃金即時圖表 | https://www.investing.com |

若您需要更精確的數字，請直接前往上述網站或使用相關金融應用程式（如 Bloomberg Terminal、Reuters Eikon 等）查詢。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). They want current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. Possibly provide approximate or say cannot fetch. We can suggest checking reliable sources. No function needed.
